# Find the line with WPWS(ns) in the summary table

else:
    print('Not found')

import re
text=open('jiwoonl__timing.txt').read()
lines=text.splitlines()
# Find header line containing 'WPWS(ns)'
header_line=None
for i,line in enumerate(lines):
    if 'WPWS(ns)' in line:
        header_line=line
        header_idx=i
        break
print('Header line:', header_line)
# Next line with numbers after header_line
value_line=None
for line in lines[header_idx+1:]:
    if re.search(r'\d', line):
        # likely the values line
        value_line=line
        break
print('Value line:', value_line)
# Split header into tokens (remove separators like -----)
header_tokens=[tok for tok in header_line.split() if not set(tok).issubset(set('-'))]
value_tokens=[tok for tok in value_line.split() if not set(tok).issubset(set('-'))]
print('Header tokens:', header_tokens)
print('Value tokens:', value_tokens)
# Map
mapping=dict(zip(header_tokens, value_tokens))
print('Mapping WPWS:', mapping.get('WPWS(ns)'))

            ys.append(y)
        except (ValueError, KeyError):
            continue
# compute Pearson correlation
n = len(xs)
mean_x = sum(xs)/n
mean_y = sum(ys)/n
cov = sum((x-mean_x)*(y-mean_y) for x,y in zip(xs,ys))
var_x = sum((x-mean_x)**2 for x in xs)
var_y = sum((y-mean_y)**2 for y in ys)
correlation = cov / math.sqrt(var_x*var_y)
print('n', n)
